counterfactual.change: Moved waypoint x from 18.1 to 5.0 so body never enters arrival radius within 14 steps; force stays clamped and no violation occurs.

explanation: Cruise-phase controller output is correctly clamped at fmax (steps 11-13 force exactly 11.346). At step 14 the hover body arrives within ~1m of its waypoint (17.35,10.16 vs 18.1,10.8) at ~50 m/s while vcmd is 12.4. The arrival/braking law then commands ~580 N, ~51x fmax, bypassing the fmax clamp applied in cruise. Likely cause: separate waypoint-capture / stopping branch that omits the force-saturation step.
vision_note: The large red body speeds toward the green waypoint in the upper right across steps 11-13 and arrives directly on top of it at step 14. The small blue body and the grey wall stay put, with no visible exit from the arena, wall penetration, or breakup.
